title: Optimal Weak-Type Estimates and Their Applications of Lifted Rough Maximal Operators
summary: Let $n\in\mathbb N\cap[2,\infty)$ and $Ω\in L^1(\mathbb S^{n-1})$ with $Ω\not\equiv 0$. In this article, we introduce a new family of lifted rough maximal operators $\{\mathcal{M}_θ^Ω\}_{θ\in(0,\infty)}$ in the upper-half plane and establish their optimal weak-type estimates.
